_meta.refresh_protocol: The Figma PAT lacks file_variables:read (Enterprise-gated), so the agent refreshes this file via Figma MCP get_variable_defs and rewrites it. NEVER hand-edit hex values; re-pull from Figma.

font.title: Lato
font._note: NU is a SINGLE-TYPEFACE system (Lato, weight = hierarchy) per Northeastern's model. All four slots resolve to Lato; weight + size carry hierarchy. Matches the NU Brand Tokens font/* variables (95:2). Google Fonts Lato lacks 600, so web title-weight is 700.

journeyMatrix._extend: Grow dimensions through auto-layout only: the matrix is a vertical stack of horizontal rows, cells set to FILL. Add a phase = add a column entry and let the row reflow; add a swimlane = add a row. Never absolute-position cells (collision-prone).
